title: NPCore: Important Systems
summary: Recognize the profile, visual, dialogue, trade, service, faction, and replacement systems behind contacts.

blocks.title: Profile Chain
blocks.body: An NPC profile points to its visual profile, dialogue tree, trade set, service set, faction, ambient lines, and interaction range.

blocks.title: Action Surfaces
blocks.body: Dialogue moves the conversation, trades exchange items with stock rules, and services spend a cost for a configured result or cooldown.

blocks.title: Replacement Contacts
blocks.body: Villager replacement data can map vanilla professions or wandering traders to ECHO profiles. In play, this turns ordinary village roles into authored contacts.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
